pigment.note: Radiation Shielding: protective red/violet pigment. Recolours masked pixels shade-for-shade; the procedural stem and branches take it too.

wax.note: Heat Tolerance: reflective wax cuticle. Level = heat tier: T1 recolours only the lit shades (2–3) — a sheen; T2 shades 1–3; T3 every shade. Applied to whichever leaf structure is active.

toothed.note: Salt Handling: tougher, toothed margins. Pixels inside the sprite's authored 'toothed' mask are CLEARED (notches cut into the margin). No mask = no teeth (for leaf forms where teeth are inappropriate).

pixel.format: PNG, 8-bit per channel; colour types RGBA (6), RGB (2), indexed (3, incl. tRNS) or grey (0 / 4); not interlaced
pixel.alpha: every pixel is fully transparent (alpha 0) or fully opaque (alpha 255); partial alpha is a build error
pixel.palette: every opaque pixel inside a sprite rect must be EXACTLY one of the pack's declared palette colours (atlas.json palette); arbitrary RGBA is a build error. A colour means a material + shade, so the renderer can recolour it (treatments, condition).
pixel.mask: a mask rect has the sprite's exact size; any opaque pixel (any colour) = inside the mask, transparent = outside
pixel.strays: no opaque pixel may lie outside every declared rect (sprite, mask, swatch)
